# Schemas: generated by the owning units

This directory holds the council's JSON Schemas in the finished
package. At this scaffold stage it intentionally contains no schema
files.

Schemas are generated artifacts, owned by the units that own the
contracts: the core contract unit (CWE-004) generates the session,
brief, verdict, and configuration schemas, and the source-pack unit
(CWE-010) generates the advisor pack schemas. Hand-writing schemas
here would fork the contracts before they exist, so this scaffold
vendors none.

When the generated schemas land, they arrive through the normal
package build, are listed in manifest.json, and are verified by
scripts/verify-bundles.mjs like every other file in the tree.
